expects.reason: Stryker.NET supports this SDK-style net8.0 solution. It runs in solution mode (the test project references OrderKit.Core and OrderKit.Services) and reports a mutation score. It comes from NuGet; where NuGet is refused it exits 4 instead. Also: the sheet makes it primary for 16 Data Flow metrics, which it cannot compute -- see roslyn-dataflow.

data.planted: arithmetic, relational and logical operators with non-equivalent boundaries
data.expected: a mutation score with surviving and killed mutants that are not all equivalent
data.note: The C# core of this folder's fixtures is C# 5-compatible, so it is identical on all 13 families and what the tool measures cannot drift between them. The LanguageMarker class in each file is what pins the file to C# 12.0; it does not compile under C# 11.0. No project manifest is present, by design.
